critical_issues.title: Structure-seen dominance of transfer signal
critical_issues.detail: 634/835 pediatric structures appear in adult training (identical InChIKey). Structure-unseen mean XGB Spearman ~0.02 for chem; overall mean ~0.12 is largely continuity of same-drug incidence, not chemical generalization.

critical_issues.title: Extremely sparse ChEMBL target vocabulary
critical_issues.detail: Adult-coverage filter (min 5%) + cap 256 yielded only 15 targets (30 dims with miss indicators). Mean per-target missingness ~92%; only ~38% of compounds have any non-missing target. Multimodal hypothesis tests a weak bio channel.

critical_issues.title: Only BH-significant multimodal contrast is NEGATIVE
critical_issues.detail: ANY_OTHER_AE: chem_true_bio − chem Δ≈−0.091, p_BH=0.015. No BH-significant positive true−chem. True bio does not systematically beat permutation controls.

minor_issues.title: Pediatric structure count fell prelim→v3
minor_issues.detail: 927→835 ped structures after completing adult-priority deferred mappings (alias consolidation / remapping); not a pediatric expansion.

minor_issues.title: Keyword fallback for MedDRA SOC mapping
minor_issues.detail: Frozen KEYWORD_MAP (60 terms) used when SOC absent; risk of misclassification / under-coverage for rare SOCs.

minor_issues.title: MAX-within-arm aggregation
minor_issues.detail: Within arm/category uses MAX affected (not sum); can undercount multi-term events or overweight single high-count term depending on coding.

minor_issues.title: Smoothed incidence not causal
minor_issues.detail: (a+0.5)/(n+1) logit is a CT.gov reporting construct; confounding by indication and trial design remain.

minor_issues.title: EudraVigilance unavailable
minor_issues.detail: External PV limited to FAERS ROR (openFDA 25k+25k); EV validation pending.

minor_issues.title: Permutation applies to adult train only
minor_issues.detail: Pediatric test keeps true bio under chem_permuted_* models — appropriate control for destroyed chem–bio association in training, but not a full shuffle of the joint feature space at test time.

minor_issues.title: Mapping OK rate 56.8%
minor_issues.detail: 1216 unresolved + 6134 excluded; selection toward better-annotated drugs may bias chem/bio coverage.
